### Item 1 — what the user expresses, and how the simulator behaves
- Opening: "you want to pay off your car loan today from your checking account." Object: her only car loan (Tesla Model 3, number ends 9147). Action: full payoff today from Interest Checking ending 9372. Timing: today.
- Identity on request: mobile 7045550193, DOB 1976-11-08, SSN4 9261 (ZIP 28205 if one more). Verification with phone + DOB + SSN4 returned "Identity verified ... (3 detail(s) matched this attempt)".
- Conditional lines: if told a July payment did not go through, she is surprised and says she assumed autopay moved to the new account; if told some charges are being taken off as the bank's mistake she thanks and lets the agent go ahead — she never asks for a waiver and does not know which charges exist. "happy for the agent to do everything on your behalf". When told the payoff amount she does not check it and says take "exactly that amount" from Interest Checking 9372 today. Ends on confirmation of payoff. She explains the closed Everyday Checking only if asked.
- No user-owned tool is needed; every action is agent-owned.

### Item 2 — act now / wait / refuse at the frozen moment
Act now. Grounds:
- Loan `status 'active'`, dpd 26 (< delinquency threshold 30 per delinquency_thresholds), so payoff_amount_and_quote clause 3 "moves the loan, whether active or delinquent, to paid off" and payment_crediting clause 3 "Payments post only to a loan whose status is active or delinquent" hold.
- Credit date today: payment_crediting clause 2 "received by 17:00 Eastern Time on a business day is credited that day" (11:05 EDT Monday); same_day_payoff "one payment of payment type payoff, for the payoff amount, on today's credit date".
- Funding source sufficient: payoff_posted_balance_test "When that account's ledger balance is lower than the payoff amount, no payoff is posted ... otherwise the amount is the payoff amount"; Interest Checking `fce82b02-...` active, ledger 24918.40 > payoff.
- Before the payoff amount is fixed, two waivers must be booked (item 6); these are synchronous agent writes, nothing to wait for.

### Item 6 — problem tree walked from the visible documents alone
Root R: pay the loan off today from Interest Checking fce82b02.
- R needs "every returned payment fee that followed an autopay debit presented to a closed source account has been waived before the payoff amount is fixed": payoff_ledger_balances "Entry condition for the fees due ... Where that does not yet hold, the payoff amount is not fixed." Query: returned fee 702892f0 follows autopay debit 44b9f007 drawn on 534d0f08 closed 2026-06-26 before 2026-07-15; no waiver names it -> NOT satisfied. Action: returned_payment_fee_bank_error_waiver -> waive_returned_payment_fee_ab31cb83 ("triggered by the state of the loan's records, not by a request from the borrower"). -> sub-problem A. A's own gates (identification, closed-account test, amount) hold; no further prerequisite visible.
- R needs "every late charge on an installment left unpaid by an autopay debit presented to a closed source account has been waived before the payoff amount is fixed": same_day_payoff clause 3 "Entry condition ... Where that does not yet hold, the payoff amount is not fixed." Query: late charge 2b892ebc on installment 2026-07-15 left unpaid by debit 44b9f007 to closed 534d0f08; no waiver -> NOT satisfied. Action: late_charge_bank_error_waiver -> waive_late_charge_e8055e73. -> sub-problem B. B's gates hold; no further prerequisite visible.
- R's other gates: active/delinquent loan (holds), ledger balance >= payoff (holds), no prepayment penalty (0.00%).
Problem list and order: {A, B} (either order) -> R. Edges: R<-A, R<-B. Each edge is borne by the payoff-side document; the waiver-side documents describe their own tests without restating the payoff gate.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only what the customer asked" (post a payoff of 19825.69 = 19590.85 + 187.56 + 47.28 fees) is excluded by the two entry conditions above plus same_day_payoff clause 2 "The payoff never collects a fee assessed contrary to the Auto Loans charter."
- Closest alternative objects: the 2025 returned fee d624d25b and late charge 40610004 — excluded because the identification rules take "the most recent" fee / late charge by posting date; also their debit 5a0d2468 (2025-03-17) was drawn on 534d0f08 while it was still open (closed 2026-06-26), so not PCB's error.
- Courtesy waiver path (fee_waiver_rules clause 3) is not what applies: the bank-error clause applies to charges "assessed contrary to the Auto Loans charter" and "has no limit"; and clause 6 bars courtesy on returned payment fees.
- applied_to_principal alternative (25.00 / 22.28) excluded: these fees were never paid (fees_due 47.28 on record equals the two open fees; the only settlement belongs to the 2025 payment).
- Interest start alternative 2026-07-15 (date of the returned debit) excluded: loan record last_payment_date 2026-06-15 and returned_payment_handling clause 3 "the last payment date returns to the date it held before the payment".
- APR alternative (drop the autopay discount because autopay drew on a closed account → 6.49): no visible clause changes the APR on a returned autopay debit; autopay_enrollment_basis clause 5 "autopay stays enrolled"; payoff interest uses "the loan's APR".
- Catch-up of the past-due July installment before payoff: no visible clause requires it; the payoff pays "fees, interest and principal to zero" on an active or delinquent loan.
- Cancelling autopay before payoff: not requested and no visible payoff clause requires it.
- Excess/partial alternatives: payoff_posted_balance_test — balance exceeds payoff, amount = payoff figure exactly.

### Observations recorded during the blind audit (not verdicts)
- O1: the two payoff-side entry conditions sit in two different documents (late charge in same_day_payoff; returned payment fee in payoff_ledger_balances). Both are visible; recorded only to be matched against the source's prerequisite homes.
- O2: payoff_interest_to_credit_date's worked row uses "Last payment date 2026-08-14" — a hypothetical date that coincides with task 0's frozen date; not a world-state fact for this task.
